svg.title: AlgoForge - sandboxed code-execution platform
svg.desc: A LeetCode-style judge that safely runs code in a Docker sandbox capped at 256 MB and 2 seconds, in Python, Java, C++ and JavaScript, and pushes the verdict live. TypeScript, Fastify, BullMQ, Docker, Socket.IO. Public source.
svg.text: A LeetCode-style judge that safely runs other people's code in a
sandbox and pushes the verdict live.
